spec.description: Exchange an app password for a session. The core calls this by itself before the first authenticated request, so a caller normally never touches it.

request.title: CreateSessionRequest
request.description: Takes nothing from the caller. The identifier and the app password belong to the client, not to the call: `Bluesky.new(identifier=..., app_password=...)` holds them and the transport injects them at send time. That is why they are not properties here, and why no recorded example of this endpoint can contain a credential -- there is no field for one to sit in.

response.title: Session
response.description: A session: two tokens and who they belong to.

accessJwt.description: Bearer token for authenticated calls. Short-lived -- minutes, not days -- so a long-running client refreshes rather than reusing it.

refreshJwt.description: Token that buys a new `accessJwt` from `server.refresh_session`. Longer-lived, and the more dangerous of the two to leak.

handle.description: Handle the session belongs to, such as `truewire.dev`.

active.description: Whether the account is active. A deactivated or taken-down account still authenticates and answers `false` here.

email.description: Account email. Present on `createSession` and absent from `refreshSession`; it is personal data, so recorded examples scrub it.

emailConfirmed.description: Whether that address has been confirmed.

notes: `redacted` names the two keys the transport injects, so `truewire mock` ignores them when matching a real call against a recorded one (ADR 0007). It does not strip anything from a recording -- nothing reaches a recording to strip, because `truewire capture` writes the request half from the parameters it was given and this endpoint takes none.
The response is scrubbed on capture: `accessJwt` and `refreshJwt` are live credentials and `email` is personal data. The recorded example proves the shape, not the values.
Use an app password (bsky.app > Settings > App Passwords), never the account password. It is individually revocable and cannot change the account's password or email.
